data.name: Hotel Monterrey Macroplaza
data.address: Morelos Oriente 574, Centro, 64000 Monterrey, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
Opposite the Macroplaza square and gardens, this upscale hotel is a 3-minute walk from a metro station and 6 minutes on foot from the Museum of Contemporary Art of Monterrey.
Straightforward rooms provide flat-screen TVs, microwaves and safes, in addition to tea and coffeemaking facilities, and free Wi-Fi. Room service is offered.
Breakfast and parking are available. Other amenities include a casual restaurant/bar, an Argentinian grill eatery and an indoor pool, as well as a gym and a TV lounge.
